name: Ok do you work better now

messages.content: Ok do you work better now that we aren’t on the airplane WiFi? Lol

Much better—solid ground and real bandwidth make a world of difference! 

What are we working on next?
Can you check my app again? Did you finish running the bug test?

Yes! The test suite finished right as the airplane Wi-Fi cut out earlier, and I just re-ran it to double-check—all **7/7 unit tests** in [app.test.mjs](file:///home/agent/workspace/test/app.test.mjs) are passing.

Here is the updated live app:
👉 **[Open Updated SubSniper App](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/902266ae-5270-49fd-98c7-3a89a30dbf49/df7ae08c9d7c26fe5e8a39fa/)**

---

### 🐛 What the Bug Scan Caught & Fixed

1. **OCR Regex Mangling `/month` into `"nth"` ([`parseSubscriptionText`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L308-L380))**:
   - Previously, `/\/(mo|month)/` matched `/mo` first and left `"nth"` behind as the subscription name. It now matches full billing words and looks 1–2 lines above the price to handle multi-line iOS Settings screenshots.
2. **Deleted Sample Data Returning on Refresh ([`loadSubscriptions`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L121-L135))**:
   - Deleting all 8 starter subscriptions used to reload the defaults on refresh because it checked `parsed.length > 0`. It now respects an empty list `[]`, and there is a **🧹 Clear Sample Data** button in the top-right header of [index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html#L35-L38).
3. **Overlapping Popups & Bottom Nav ([`openModal`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L666-L675) & [`closeAllModals`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L654-L657))**:
   - Tapping the bottom tabs while a sheet was open stacked multiple sheets on top of each other, and the **📊 Dashboard** tab didn't close open sheets. Switching tabs now cleanly closes any open popup.
4. **Evening Timezone Day-Shift Bug ([`daysFromNow`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L14-L18) & [`daysUntil`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L20-L28))**:
   - Using UTC `.toISOString()` shifted dates forward by a day in the evening local time. Switched to local device dates.
5. **iPhone Screenshot OCR Performance & Live Editing ([`downscaleImageForOcr`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L483-L514) & [`renderOcrDetectedList`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L684-L711))**:
   - High-res iPhone screenshots are now automatically downscaled on canvas so mobile Safari doesn't freeze during OCR, and you can edit scanned names/prices inline before importing.
6. **Commas Inside Quoted Capital One CSVs ([`splitCsvLine`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L383-L406) & [`parseCapitalOneCsv`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L409-L480))**:
   - Merchant names with commas (like `"NETFLIX.COM, LOS GATOS, CA"`) broke basic `.split(",")` parsing. Replaced with a quote-aware CSV parser that also filters out credit card payment rows.
7. **Added "Edit Subscription" ([`openEditSub`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L778-L791))**:
   - Tapping any subscription now lets you edit its name, price, cycle, source, or renewal date instead of only deleting it.

I attached an image: .antigravity/uploads/photo-1794090790-1.jpg.

Why are things getting cut off?

Looking at your screenshot, **4 different things** were getting cut off—I just fixed all of them:

👉 **[Open Fixed SubSniper App](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/902266ae-5270-49fd-98c7-3a89a30dbf49/df7ae08c9d7c26fe5e8a39fa/)**

---

### Why They Were Cut Off & What Was Fixed

1. **Scanned iOS Names Cut Off at the Beginning (`0 AppleCare One`, `one Premier`, `®) Pro Monthly`)**:
   - **Why it happened:**
     - **Apple One (`one Premier`):** In iOS Settings, Apple writes **Apple One** using the Apple logo symbol (`One`), which the OCR engine couldn't read as letters—so it dropped `` and left `one Premier`.
     - **App Icons (`0 ` and `®)`):** The OCR scanner tried to read the square app icons on the left edge of your screenshot as text (`0` and `®)`).
     - **`Pro Monthly`:** In iOS Settings, the app name sits *2 lines above* the `$14.99/month` price, with the plan subtitle (`Pro Monthly`) in between. The scanner stopped at `Pro Monthly` instead of looking one line higher for the app name.
   - **Fix ([`cleanScannedName`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L172-L185) & [`parseSubscriptionText`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L377-L465)):** The scanner now strips icon symbols (`0 `, `®)`), restores `One` to `Apple One Premier`, and looks above plan subtitles (`Pro Monthly`, `Premier`) to grab the real app name. It also **auto-repairs the items already saved on your phone** ([`sanitizeSubscriptionList`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L187-L199)) as soon as you reload.

2. **Subscription Titles Cut Off with `...` (`YouTube Pre...`)**:
   - **Why it happened:** Each card forced the subscription name, the `▶️ Google Play` badge, and the `TRIAL` badge onto a single cramped line next to the price.
   - **Fix ([`renderDashboard`](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js#L690-L712) & [styles.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/styles.css#L508-L542)):** Moved the source and `TRIAL` badges onto the second row next to the renewal date so the subscription name gets the full width of the card.

3. **`💳 Capital One` Filter Button Cut Off on the Right Edge**:
   - **Why it happened:** The 4 filter buttons were slightly wider than the iPhone screen width.
   - **Fix ([index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html#L115-L121) & [styles.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/styles.css#L435-L456)):** Shortened `"All Subscriptions"` to `"All"` and made all 4 filter pills flex equally across the screen so none of them clip off the right side.

4. **Top Content Sliding Under the Dynamic Island / Clock (`5:32`)**:
   - **Why it happened:** Scrolling pushed buttons directly behind the iOS status bar and Dynamic Island.
   - **Fix ([styles.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/styles.css#L19-L34)):** Added a blurred top status-bar shield (`.ios-status-shield`) and increased top/bottom safe-area spacing.
